title: Record a discovered problem after work was marked complete
actor: An engineer who discovers a problem in previously completed work
goal: Record the newly observed problem and its explicitly supplied basis without silently changing prior engineering decisions.
context: A completed Change retains its historical acceptance account; a later regression or an error in that original account has been discovered.
trigger: The engineer chooses linked new corrective work or an explicit completion annotation.
preconditions: The engineer identifies the completed Change and supplies current authority and the required inputs for the chosen new-work or annotation task.

interaction.action: Identifies a later regression or a mistake in an earlier completion account, preserving the distinction.
Provides the compact historical completion without presenting it as a claim about current repository health.
Creates linked new corrective work for the regression, or supplies an explicit annotation for a mistaken original account.
Records the selected current problem or annotation without reopening work, rewriting historical completion or granting authority.

expected_outcome: A new regression is actionable through a new linked Change while the earlier completion keeps its original meaning; an original-assessment error can be explicitly annotated.

alternatives.condition: A finding was raised during active work before completion.
alternatives.outcome: It remains in the active handoff until explicitly dispositioned; it cannot disappear through replacement of working evidence.

failures.condition: An update attempts to silently overwrite a completion conclusion or hide an unresolved active issue.
failures.outcome: Reject the update and require an explicit correction annotation or issue disposition.

failures.condition: The selected state changed before publication.
failures.outcome: The system reports conflict and requires the engineer to reread and decide again.
